title: TCL introduces new tablet lineup, bringing productivity and entertainment together
summary: Tablets have earned their place as the ultimate portable companion—versatile devices you can open anywhere to stay entertained or productive around the clock. When packed with cutting-edge innovation…

blocks.text: Tablets have earned their place as the ultimate portable companion—versatile devices you can open anywhere to stay entertained or productive around the clock. When packed with cutting-edge innovation and feature-rich performance, they redefine what everyday tech can do. TCL, the Philippines’ No. 1 Panel TV brand, expands its tech portfolio with a new tablet lineup—from versatile everyday devices to premium models powered by TCL NXTPAPER technology. Blending immersive displays, sleek design, and solid performance, these tablets offer tailored solutions for entertainment, productivity, and everyday creativity.

TCL is introducing not just one, but five new tablet models designed to meet every lifestyle. Packed with specialized features, each model is built to handle everything from intense gaming and immersive entertainment to pressing work deadlines.

“The wait is over as TCL unveils its most anticipated device lineup yet: the new TCL Tablets. Engineered with TCL’s proprietary, eye-friendly display technology, these devices deliver a paper-like visual experience that drastically reduces eye strain and screen fatigue,” says TCL CEO Peter Chen.
The Ultimate Work Companion

blocks.caption: TCL Introduces New Tablet Lineup, Bringing Productivity and Entertainment Together

blocks.text: Leading the lineup is the TCL Note A1 NXTPAPER—an 11.5-inch hybrid digital notebook and Android tablet. It combines the tactile feel of writing on paper with vibrant, full-color visuals and smooth video-streaming performance.

A versatile digital pad designed for professionals marking up documents and creators capturing their next big idea. The Note A1’s large display leverages TCL’s NXTPAPER Pure Display technology to deliver a true paper-like feel with under 2.44% blue-light emission. It has Paper-Like, Lag-Free Display, Natural Precision Writing with the included T-Pen Pro, AI-Driven Productivity and Ultra-Thin Design (500 g | 5.5 mm).

Backed by TÜV and SGS certifications and protected by 3A Crystal Shield Glass, the screen resists glares, reflections, and fingerprints—offering an eye-friendly, paper-true space for reading, writing, and creating.

blocks.caption: TCL Introduces New Tablet Lineup, Bringing Productivity and Entertainment Together

blocks.text: Maximizing Work and Play

blocks.caption: TCL Introduces New Tablet Lineup, Bringing Productivity and Entertainment Together

blocks.text: Made for eye-friendly reading, writing, and productivity, the TCL TAB A1 Plus NXTPAPER features an expansive 12.2-inch 2.4K display powered by TCL’s signature screen technology. It delivers vivid colors and crisp details while reducing eye strain.

Designed as an all-in-one productivity hub, the TCL TAB A1 Plus NXTPAPER serves as a seamless laptop alternative built to power through demanding daily schedules. Powered by a massive 10,000mAh battery, it delivers long-lasting battery life for uninterrupted creation, document editing, and video conferences without constant trips to the charger. Whether you’re managing complex workflows, multitasking across open applications with split-screen capability, or relaxing with crisp streaming media after hours, it effortlessly transitions between intensive work and immersive entertainment on a single, high-performance display.

Built to support extended productivity, it serves as a capable laptop alternative for everyday work while transitioning effortlessly into a high-powered entertainment hub. Complete with the T-Pen 2 and dedicated Keyboard Case out of the box, it offers an all-in-one setup that elevates note-taking, document editing, and creative workflows, making it the ultimate multitasking companion for work and play.
Lightweight Mobility for Everyday Use

Powered by a massive 10,000mAh battery, the TCL TAB A1 Plus NXTPAPER delivers reliable, long-lasting performance, making it the ultimate go-to device for everyday work and entertainment on a larger, far more immersive screen than standard smartphones. Its expansive display provides a paper-like, glare-free digital reading experience that reduces eye strain whether you’re diving into long documents, news feeds, or e-books.

Perfect for professionals on the move, it functions as a portable workstation for checking emails, reviewing presentations, and managing light tasks while commuting. When the workday wraps up, the tablet effortlessly transitions into a personal theater, bringing movies, videos, and media to life with vibrant, crisp clarity that keeps you engaged anywhere.
All-Out Entertainment, Limitless Play

blocks.caption: TCL Introduces New Tablet Lineup, Bringing Productivity and Entertainment Together

blocks.text: The TCL TAB A1 PLUS features a vibrant 12.2-inch display boasting a crisp 2400 x 1600 resolution. Engineered for visual clarity and rich color reproduction, the high-definition LCD panel delivers a sharp, bright viewing experience.

Powered by an energy-efficient 4nm Snapdragon 4 Gen 2 processor, the device enables seamless multitasking, stable gaming, and extended streaming sessions. For resource-intensive workloads, its high-speed LPDDR5 memory delivers accelerated data access to keep pace with demanding daily tasks.

The TCL TAB A1 Plus is also equipped with an ultra-smooth 120Hz NXTPAPER display, delivering a fluid visual performance that seamlessly bridges the gap between productivity and entertainment. Its high-refresh-rate screen ensures silky-smooth navigation and responsive touch performance when multitasking across heavy work applications, editing documents, or switching between split-screen tasks. When it’s time to unwind, the display transforms into an immersive media center, rendering movies, videos, and streaming content with crisp detail and natural clarity. For casual gaming and fast-paced visual media, the 120Hz refresh rate eliminates lag and motion blur, offering an exceptionally fluid visual experience that adapts effortlessly to whatever your day demands.
Ultra-Slim. Extremely Light.

If you’re looking for the best value in a slim, lightweight tablet, the TCL TAB A1 is built for you. Designed for everyday streaming, reading, and productivity, this budget-friendly Android tablet features an expansive 11-inch display with slim 6.7mm bezels—offering a cleaner, more immersive view with minimal distraction.

Designed as an all-in-one digital hub for every member of the household, the TCL TAB A1 combines lightweight portability with family-friendly performance. Weighing just 430g with an ultra-slim 6.2mm metal unibody design, it is sleek enough for parents to manage daily tasks on the go and comfortable enough for kids to hold during interactive learning sessions. Its expansive 11-inch 2.1K display brings content to life with exceptional clarity—whether the family is streaming movies, reading e-books, engaging in educational apps, or managing light work and homework. Coupled with robust eye-care protection, long-lasting battery life, and smooth performance, the TCL TAB A1 effortlessly transitions from a productivity assistant to an engaging, safe entertainment companion for all ages.

Featuring a crisp 2.1K resolution, the display renders videos, photos, documents, and web pages with remarkable detail and clarity for work, study, and leisure. Paired with a 90Hz refresh rate, scrolling, browsing, and app navigation remain fluid and responsive throughout daily use.
To view more of the specs, log on to https://www.tcl.com/ph/en/tablets.
